brain.commentary: The portfolio is heavily crypto‑centric and sits in a risk‑on cross‑asset regime. Core pairs (BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC) show elevated volatility, negative alpha and weak liquidity, leading to a moderate‑to‑high tail‑risk profile (95% ES around -5% to -8%). Many of the smaller altcoins have zero volatility and risk metrics, indicating data gaps and fragility. To preserve capital we modestly dial back conviction across the board, with the greatest reductions on the most fragile signals (LTC, SOL, ETH).
